description: Blog Investigations store. Digest focuses on 6 user orientations (per post).

changelog_features.meaning: Newly supported functionalities that enhance the agent itself
include: new agent UX that expands capability
exclude: merely adding a model to a picker

applications.meaning: How applications are used — list concrete usages

model_release_benchmark.meaning: Proprietary (or closed/frontier) model releases framed by benchmarks

cost_efficiency_rules.policy: Prefer official pricing. metrics key is OPTIONAL on cards — omit when unpublished. Never invent. Prefer USD/MTok; if only CNY published, store CNY and note currency.

benchmark_comparison_rules.attach: 1–2 famous benchmarks with peer comparison (e.g. Claude Opus/Fable vs GPT-6 Astra)
benchmark_comparison_rules.policy: Use provider tables or independent leaderboards only. Note harness/version mismatches. Never invent scores.

model_release_benchmark_with_implementat.meaning: Model releases that also disclose architecture/implementation details
fields_to_extract: components (Sparse Attention, MLP / Gated Delta Net, MHC, Mamba, …)

note: research / changelog_bugfix / changelog_refactor may still be stored with legacy tags but are out of the primary 6-type digest unless user asks.

post_fields.title: string
post_fields.category: one of the 5 digest categories (changelog_features|applications|engineering|model_release_benchmark|model_release_benchmark_with_implementations) or optional legacy
post_fields.orientation: optional structured notes matching the category's extract fields

fields.title: string
fields.source: string e.g. OpenAI or Cognition / Blog
fields.metrics: OPTIONAL object {pricing?, benchmarks?} — omit key entirely when unknown; never invent

ingest.tracker_cards_ingest: POST /tracker-cards-ingest — one card body; metrics optional
